name: Metaball-based Envelope Painting
definition: A technique for defining 3D envelopes (selections) within volumetric data using implicit surfaces (metaballs) that merge based on proximity, allowing for organic shapes and continuous extrusion.
summary: Metaball-based Envelope Painting defines a volume of interest by painting merging implicit envelopes, replacing complex transfer function tuning with an intuitive spatial marking metaphor.
